limitations: No database subscription access or exhaustive citation snowballing.
Publisher abstracts/metadata do not establish a full-text critical review.
Some conference records are short papers, extended abstracts, or demonstrations and are labeled.
P01/P02 are related versions in one evidence family, not independent replications.
Repository documentation was inspected; no baseline source commit was cloned or benchmarked.
No numerical faculty workload cap or universal program-compliance rule was adopted.
